notes: IDs are proposals until added to contract/ids/sfx.json (FE-owned). The five IDs marked in_contract are the examples already listed in docs/spec/contract.md section 2.
One-shot SFX are normalised to -1 dBTP true peak (consistent peaks); set the mix with volume_db.
Ambience loops: -24 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -3 dBTP. Spaces Studio room tone is -36 LUFS.

Music: each district's full mix (pad+bass+drums+lead) is -17 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -2 dBTP. All stems of a district have identical sample length and start together; see audio/README.md for the market_mood rules.
Stingers duck the music bus (spec). LiveKit voice ducks the music bus by 6 dB (spec).
